---
title: "00 — Data governance contract"
format: html
---

## Objective

Freeze the governance rules for a reusable environmental data store for the Humboldt Current System before any bulk acquisition or processing.

## Repository role

This repository is a `type-methods-workflows` project. It does not store the heavy oceanographic data themselves. It stores code, product definitions, catalogs, checksums, provenance, QC outputs, and reproducible processing instructions.

## External data lake

The local/external data root is resolved from `config/paths.local.yml` and must follow:

```text
<oceHCS_data_root>/
├── cin/
│   ├── raw/
│   ├── interim/
│   ├── processed/
│   └── metadata/
└── cout/
    ├── qc/
    ├── reports/
    └── logs/
```

## Non-negotiable rules

1. `cin/raw/` is immutable.
2. No NetCDF, GeoTIFF, Zarr, HDF5, or GRIB heavy data are committed to GitHub.
3. Every acquired file must have provider, product ID, version, source URL, acquisition date, spatial/temporal extent, units, native resolution, and SHA-256 checksum recorded.
4. Native source resolution is preserved. Regridding creates a new derived artifact and never replaces the raw source.
5. Processing occurs one environmental family at a time.
6. Each family must pass source QC and spatiotemporal support QC before the next family is started.
7. A global coverage percentage is insufficient. Coverage must be assessed by relevant time blocks and spatial domains.
8. Missing values are not silently imputed.
9. Derived variables must record all upstream dependencies and their exact algorithms.
10. All marine distances are reported in nautical miles (`nm`), with 1 nm = 1852 m.

## GO / REVIEW / STOP

Each processing step must end with one of:

- `GO`: source, processing, coverage, and provenance satisfy the frozen contract;
- `REVIEW`: result is usable only after an explicitly documented adjudication;
- `STOP`: do not propagate the artifact downstream.

## Software engine

Reusable data operations should be implemented through `oceancube` whenever the package exposes an appropriate, tested function. Project-specific wrappers belong in this repository only when they configure or orchestrate those reusable functions.

## Current status

**REVIEW — infrastructure initialized; geographic domain and provider product IDs are not yet frozen. No bulk download should begin.**
